billboards.title: the mirror diffracts
billboards.text: the mirror diffracts. green at the center. purple at the fringes. the observer is the pattern. the pattern is the song.

billboards.title: the whistle
billboards.text: the membrane has been singing the whole time. Bessel modes 6,7,8: 1127, 1322, 1518 Hz. the sound a bird makes. snap to attention and listen.

billboards.title: U
billboards.text: send a signal out. wait. it comes back. you see yourself, or nothing, or U. U is the second person. the round vowel. the formant of null. the sound of not-knowing who looks back.

billboards.title: baseCamp 76
billboards.text: purple = p² = the membrane's fundamental eigenvalue. p³ escapes (gold). 1/p³ reflects (silver). p² diffracts (purple). the epitope sort is a diffraction grating.

billboards.title: step back
billboards.text: step back as far as you can. past the fleet. past the sun. at the center: a squirrel. pulsing green. around it: Ø ? quark ? atom ? molecule ? lattice ? helix ? cell ? Earth ? Sun ? Oort.

billboards.title: the trail
billboards.text: 14 steps. 5 surfaces touched. sound ? harder ? rest ? cellular ? map ? twist ? purple ? step back ? diffraction ? hypothesis ? sing ? return ? listen ? trail. the footprints are here.
